longTitle.officialTitle: To take certain land located in San Diego County, California, into trust for the benefit of the Pala Band of Mission Indians, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Pala Band of Mission Indians Land Transfer Act of 2023”.

section.heading: TRANSFER OF LAND IN TRUST FOR THE PALA BAND OF MISSION INDIANS.

paragraph.heading: Transfer of lands into trust.—
paragraph.content: If, not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Tribe transfers title to the land referred to in subsection (b) to the United States, the Secretary, not later than 180 days after such transfer, shall take that land into trust for the benefit of the Tribe.

paragraph.heading: Administration.—
paragraph.content: The land transferred under paragraph (1) shall be part of the Pala Indian Reservation and administered in accordance with the laws and regulations generally applicable to land held in trust by the United States for an Indian Tribe.

subsection.heading: Land Description.—
subsection.content: The land referred to in subsection (a)(1) is the approximately 721.12 acres of land located in San Diego County, California, generally depicted as “Gregory Canyon Property Boundary” on the map titled “Pala Gregory Canyon Property Boundary and Parcels”.

paragraph.content: enlarge, impair, or otherwise affect any right or claim of the Tribe to any land or interest in land that is in existence before the date of the enactment of this Act;
affect any water right of the Tribe in existence before the date of the enactment of this Act; or
terminate or limit any access in any way to any right-of-way or right-of-use issued, granted, or permitted before the date of the enactment of this Act.

subsection.heading: Restricted Use of Transferred Lands.—
subsection.chapeau: The Tribe may not conduct, on the land taken into trust for the Tribe pursuant to this Act, gaming activities—

paragraph.content: as a matter of claimed inherent authority; or
under any Federal law, including the Indian Gaming Regulatory Act (25 U.S.C. 2701 et seq.) and regulations promulgated by the Secretary or the National Indian Gaming Commission under that Act.

subsection.heading: Definitions.—
subsection.chapeau: For the purposes of this section:

paragraph.heading: Secretary.—
paragraph.content: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

paragraph.heading: Tribe.—
paragraph.content: The term “Tribe” means the Pala Band of Mission Indians.
